alkylation reagent: A carboxyamidomethylated cysteine building block was used to eliminate the need for cysteine modification prior to MS analysis.
cleavage agent: generation and multimodal LC-MS/MS analysis of >330,000 synthetic tryptic peptides
collision energy: HCD scan with 28% normalized collision energy and Orbitrap readout
fragmentation method: HCD scan with 28% normalized collision energy... CID scan with 35% normalized collision energy... ETD scan using charge dependent ETD parameters... EThcD scan... ETciD scan
instrument: The HPLC system was coupled on-line to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: no labeling strategy is mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
